get.description: Available in API-driven standalone mode, with the YAML configuration provider and Admin API enabled. Returns the accepted configuration snapshot and its version and digest metadata, not a worker synchronization report. See [API-Driven Standalone Mode Usage](/apisix/reference/api-standalone-usage).

500.description: Failed to retrieve or encode stored configuration.

put.description: Replace the complete API-driven standalone configuration. X-Digest is a required client-supplied identifier. A matching digest returns 204 without applying the body. Otherwise the snapshot is stored and broadcast asynchronously; 202 does not confirm synchronization of all workers. Omitted resource sections may remove existing resources unless the corresponding configuration version is retained.

202.description: Configuration accepted; asynchronous worker update scheduled.

500.description: Failed to store or broadcast the configuration.

parameters.name: X-Digest
parameters.description: Client-chosen identifier for this snapshot. Use a new value for changed content.

head.description: Returns `200 OK` when the API-driven standalone configuration endpoint is reachable, including before any snapshot is loaded. When available, digest and last-modified metadata are returned in headers. This endpoint does not confirm worker synchronization.

500.description: Failed to retrieve or encode stored configuration.
